quote_zh: To a clean and pre-dried 250mL round bottomed flask, dichloromethane (160mL) NMSBA (27g, 0.11mol) and 1,3-cyclohexanedione(12g, 0.11mol) were added under stirring at the temperature of 25-30°C. To this mixture, N,N’-dicyclohexylcarbodiimide (DCC) (24g, 0.12mol) was added and stirred for about2 hours at 25-30°C. The reaction mixture was quenched with water (160mL) and separated the organic layer. The organic layer obtained was concentrated to obtain enol ester as white crystalline solid. HPLC purity >85%; Yield: 25.4g (68%); Melting point: 158-163°C and Solvent recovery: >85%.
